tool.name: BioMate trial FastQC
tool.description: Read quality control with explicit HTML and ZIP artifacts
tool.command: mkdir -p qc_output && fastqc --format fastq --threads $threads --outdir qc_output '$reads' && cp qc_output/*_fastqc.html '$html' && cp qc_output/*_fastqc.zip '$archive'
tool.help: Functional trial wrapper. A completed execution can contain QC warnings or failures; inspect the report before interpreting data quality.
